task_profile.supported_observation: The author perceived Javanese elements as more prominent than Sundanese elements at one wedding they attended.
task_profile.evidence_scope: One retrospective first-person account; no contemporaneous field notes or supplementary interviews were supplied.

residual_findings.lesson: Visual numbering may be correct while the DOCX section model remains fragile; prefer a dedicated cover section and a body section restarted at one.
Embedded non-decorative institutional imagery must carry meaningful OOXML alternative text.

reusable_writing_controls: Separate direct observation from interpretation, literature context and inference.
Do not invent missing event dates, locations, participants, motives or ritual details.
Limit generalization when only one retrospective experience is available.
Use natural academic Indonesian with varied sentence structure and precise transitions.
Avoid repetitive templates and formulaic contrastive constructions.
Do not optimize content for AI-detector evasion or similarity-score manipulation.
production_gates: Validate a human-confirmed task or institution formatting profile.
Render the final DOCX to PDF after the last edit.
Check cover suppression and the complete displayed page-number sequence in PDF.
Map TOC headings to displayed page numbers, distinct from physical PDF indexes.
Check page geometry, margins, Normal style and run-level typography.
Review every rendered page for clipping, overlap, blank pages and awkward page composition.
Audit image alternative text and bibliography metadata independently.
Keep original artifacts and case hashes in the private workspace only.
Do not label a technically checked draft as institutionally accepted or fully reviewed.
limitations: This is one assignment case, not a representative sample of academic writing or university formatting.
The layout auditor relies on extractable PDF text and may miss rasterized page numbers.
Automated TOC heading matching is heuristic and requires human visual review.
A structural PASS does not certify visual aesthetics, citation truth, academic validity or institutional acceptance.
